text.en:
[ e C j j55 J; No. S 34. THE CENSUS ENACTMENT (Cap. 78). In exercise of powers conferred upon him by subsection (1) of Section 4 of the Census Enact­ ment (Cap. 78), His Highness the Sultan has appointed the following District Officers to be Assist­ ant Superintendents of Census for the State :- District Officer, Brunei & Muara; District Officer, Belait; District Officer, Tutong; District Officer, Temburong. By Command.

WAN AHMAD State Secretary, Brunei. [Ref: SUK.8j60J.
